summary: Verified per-batch audit handoff with chained SSE manifest and resume-token mismatch
description: Issue summary: Customer requested a per-batch signed audit handoff for a mid-month compliance review. They received an exported bundle from our S3 archive with a signed manifest and per-batch resume tokens, but the tokens are non-monotonic and one batch checksum fails verification. Impact: prevents FinDelta compliance team from ingesting the archive into their SIEM (Graylog) and blocks regulatory evidence delivery for an ongoing audit. Request: verify provenance, provide corrected bundle and an attestation statement with key identifiers (KID), wrapping keys used for cross-border transfer, and recommended ingestion checks for the customer's SIEM.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer requested on-demand export for account findelta-prod for date range 2026-02-25 to 2026-03-05 via support portal
2) Support generated export using internal export playbook and delivered S3 presigned URL to customer (link redacted in ticket),
3) Customer downloaded bundles and ran provided verify_manifest.sh against manifest.json
4) verify_manifest.sh raised a checksum mismatch for batch_20260301_17.zip and flagged resume token sequence jump between batch_20260301_16 and batch_20260301_17
logs: Verification tool error: checksum mismatch for batch_20260301_17 (expected 1f8b2a..., got 9c3d7b...)
Export worker logs (exporter-3): WARN exported batch sequence out-of-order at 2026-03-01T17:02:04Z
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Sofia Martinez (Support): Customer reports signature verifies but resume_token sequence not monotonic and one batch checksum fails. Customer needs a corrected artifact before 2026-03-13 for audit window.
2026-03-10 10:03 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Acknowledged. Reproducing locally against ej-20260310-9981. Checking exporter worker ordering guarantees and manifest generator race conditions.
2026-03-10 14:27 - Elena Rossi (Security): Confirmed KID redwood-eu-2025-rotate-v3 is current. Will provide key fingerprint and KMS envelope info for attestation if export integrity confirmed.

2026-03-11 08:09 - Customer (FinDelta Bank - Compliance): We cannot ingest until the resume tokens are strictly increasing. Please advise if the manifest is authoritative or if we should re-download individual batches pending verification.

2026-03-11 16:45 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Uploaded re-generated manifest and checksum file to internal bucket for verification. Asking customer to re-run verify_manifest.sh and confirm. Linked PR for temporary idempotent manifest generator: github.com/redwood-inference/exporter/pull/4231

2026-03-12 11:10 - Sofia Martinez (Support): Customer confirmed re-run shows monotonic tokens and all checksums pass. Preparing attestation letter and cross-border key wrap details for delivery. Marking In Progress until final attestation delivered.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: exporter worker had transient re-queue leading to out-of-order batch file generation; manifest generator consumed incomplete batch list and emitted tokens based on observed order rather than logical sequence.

Findings: exporter-3 reported a retry at 2026-03-01T17:01:58Z due to transient EFS NFS timeout; retry produced batch with older resume token tok_000014 which was later persisted before higher token tok_000016 on a different worker.
Checksum mismatch traced to a partial multipart upload that completed with different ETag after a retry; verify_manifest.sh expects deterministic gz checksum (we use sha256 over final object).

Temporary mitigation implemented in PR 4231: manifest generator will now query DynamoDB batch index for canonical sequence numbers (sequence_id) instead of relying on object list order and will revalidate ETag/sha256 prior to signing the manifest.

Security check: signature key kid verified by Security (Elena Rossi). KMS envelope uses eu-keyring-01 with rsa-oaep-256 wrapping; cross-border transfer uses customer-provided KMS-wrapped KEK (we recorded their KID).
resolution: Provided corrected export bundle and signed attestation. Workaround: re-generated bundle with idempotent manifest and verified checksums; customer re-ingested into Graylog successfully. Permanent fix: merged exporter/pull/4231 to ensure canonical batch ordering and pre-signing checksum validation; scheduled regression tests and a postmortem for 2026-03-20. Follow-ups: add monitoring alert for exporter worker retries and a dashboard panel for export manifest mismatch rate.
